description: Decode percent-encoded text (decodeURIComponent, or decodeURI with mode "full"). Optionally turn "+" into spaces (form encoding). Errors on malformed %-sequences. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/url-toolkit/

mode.description: "component" = encodeURIComponent (for one query value or path segment; escapes / ? & = #). "full" = encodeURI (a whole URL; keeps those).

name: url_decode
title: URL decode
